body:
Fixes:
1. 30 pots in 5 groups but only 2 garden levels. Fix: level 1 = beds + pots at gardening 10. Level 2 = pots at 20 and 30. Level 3 = pots at 40 and 50.
2. Old saves: someone at gardening 25 already has 12 pots. Fix: they get garden level 2 free (level 3 free at 40+). Nothing disappears.
3. The game keeps only your last Pet Show, no win count. Fix: wins count from the update on.
4. License: the judge Sir Barkley hands it over at your 3rd win. Ms. Paws: "A snake needs an animal license. Win 3 Pet Shows!" Shop: 🔒 3 Pet Show wins.
Picks:
5. Pet yard has no skill gate (garden has). Same rule?
A) Pet yard 2 at pets level 20, 3 at 40
B) No skill gate for the pet yard
6. Saturday comes every 105 real minutes, the show is open about 8.5 minutes, one show each. 3 wins = at least 3.5 real hours, harder with friends in.
A) 3 wins, as you said
B) 3 times in the top 3

comments.text:
Done: your answers in chat, 31 Oct. 1: pots untouched. 2: not needed. 3, 4: OK.
4 and 6 became 'Animal license' (3 levels). 5: new question.
